c74object.name: mc.syncSuite.leveller~
c74object.digest: Slow loudness leveller for speaker layouts: one transparent gain towards a BS.1770 target.
c74object.description: A slow gain rider that brings the programme to a loudness target. Measurement: ITU-R BS.1770-4 over the whole layout (K-weighting, the 1.41 surround weight for speakers at 60..120 degrees, LFE excluded), momentary (400 ms) or short-term (3 s), every 100 ms. ONE GAIN FOR EVERY CHANNEL: levels between speakers, and the image, never change. The gain moves towards target - loudness at most up / down dB per second, within +max_boost / -max_cut; below the gate (target + gate) it holds, so silence and pauses are not pumped up; inside the tolerance it does not move. No lookahead, no latency, no compression: a slow fader. The gain applied is exactly the gain metered. Display: the last minute of input and output loudness against the target (cyan) and the gate (dashed), gated stretches shaded, the gain underneath (pink = boost, cyan = cut), IN / OUT / GAIN and the state (LEVELLING, GATED, FROZEN). Pair it with mc.syncSuite.limiter~ after it for a safe output.

method.name: signal
method.description: A multichannel signal, one channel per speaker (up to 128).

method.name: get
method.digest: Output the loudness and the gain
method.description: loudness <in M> <in S> <out M> <out S> (LUFS), gain <applied> <desired> (dB), gated <0|1>.

method.name: reset
method.description: The gain returns to 0 dB at once (at the next audio block).

attribute.name: speaker_coords
attribute.description: One azimuth per channel (channel i = speaker i), the same message syncSuite.nodes uses and outputs (get_speakers). Empty = an even ring of the non-LFE channels straddling the front (2 = L/R, 4 = quad, 8 = octagon).

attribute.name: speaker_elevations
attribute.description: Degrees, up, one per channel (missing = 0). All spatial computations are in 3D; the displays are top views.

attribute.name: lfe
attribute.description: Channels that are LFE: they have no position and are kept out of the spatial processing and the loudness. lfe with no values = none.

attribute.name: target
attribute.description: Loudness target (LUFS). -23 = EBU R128 broadcast, -16 / -14 = streaming.

attribute.name: window
attribute.digest: Measurement: momentary (400 ms) or short-term (3 s)
attribute.description: What the gain follows: momentary (400 ms, faster) or short (short-term, 3 s, default). Values: 0 = momentary, 1 = short (a number or the name). Default: 1.

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: Measurement: momentary (400 ms) or short-term (3 s)

attribute.name: max_boost
attribute.description: Most the gain can go up (dB). Default: 9.

attribute.name: max_cut
attribute.description: Most the gain can go down (dB). Default: 12.

attribute.name: up
attribute.description: Fastest rise (dB per second). Default: 1.

attribute.name: down
attribute.description: Fastest fall (dB per second). Default: 3.

attribute.name: gate
attribute.digest: Gate (LU below the target: holds below it)
attribute.description: Below target + gate (LU) the gain holds (default -20: with target -23, below -43 LUFS).

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: Gate (LU below the target: holds below it)

attribute.name: tolerance
attribute.description: The gain does not move for deviations inside +- tolerance (LU). Default: 0.5.

attribute.name: loudness_weights
attribute.description: bs1770: 1.41 for speakers at 60..120 degrees (with speaker_coords), 1 elsewhere; flat: 1 for every non-LFE channel. Values: 0 = bs1770, 1 = flat (a number or the name).

attribute.name: freeze
attribute.description: 1: the gain holds where it is. Default: 0.

attribute.name: view
attribute.description: Which panels are drawn: all, or one of them filling the box. Values: 0 = all, 1 = history, 2 = numbers (a number or the name). Default: 0.

attribute.name: bypass_ui
attribute.description: 1: nothing is drawn and the display timer stops; the audio and the message output are not affected (use it when the box is hidden or while performing). Default: 0.

attribute.name: output
attribute.description: 1: the measurements (see get) are output at every display refresh with new data. 0: only on get.

attribute.name: interval
attribute.description: Display refresh and output rate. The processing does not depend on it. Default: 33.

attribute.name: no_ui
attribute.digest: No UI: a plain object box
attribute.description: Type it with the object (mc.syncSuite.limiter~ @no_ui 1): the box looks and sizes like a standard object box, draws nothing, runs no display timer and skips the display-only metering. Max decides per class whether a box is a UI box, so the box stays resizable, but it behaves as a standard object: audio, messages and get work as usual. Default: 0.

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: No UI: a plain object box

attribute.name: bgcolor
attribute.description: Box background (syncSuite style: near black).

attribute.name: panelcolor
attribute.description: Panel background.

attribute.name: textcolor
attribute.description: Labels and numbers.

attribute.name: gridcolor
attribute.description: Scales and guides.

attribute.name: color
attribute.description: Main signal colour (syncSuite hot pink).

attribute.name: alarmcolor
attribute.description: Overs, clips, gated / frozen states (acid yellow).

inlet.digest: Speaker feeds (channel i = speaker i) and messages

outlet.digest: Levelled speaker feeds (one gain for all)
Measurements: loudness <in M> <in S> <out M> <out S>, gain <applied> <desired>, gated <0|1>
